items.definition:
the state of being unstable
The country is facing political instability.

a small, irregular piece
There was a small lump in the sugar.

a civil officer who administers the law
The magistrate heard the case in court.

a significant stage or event
Finishing the project was a major milestone for the team.

a city or town with its own local government
The municipality is responsible for waste collection.

a substance that provides nourishment
Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.

a building for observing astronomical phenomena
We visited the observatory to look at the stars.

a prediction of the future
The ancient prophecy spoke of a great hero.

a gesture of respect
The soldiers gave a crisp salute to the officer.

seriousness, harshness
The severity of the storm caused widespread damage.

an area of land; a short treatise
They own a large tract of forest.

a pleasing view, especially one seen through a long, narrow opening
The hotel room offered a stunning vista of the mountains.

the prevailing fashion or style at a particular time
That style of dress is currently in vogue.

a starting point for comparison
We need to establish a baseline for our measurements.

captive
The escaped captive was quickly recaptured.

contamination
They worked to prevent further contamination of the site.

cutter
He used a box cutter to open the package.

fracture
He suffered a hairline fracture in his leg.

gaze
Her gaze was fixed on the distant horizon.

highland
They hiked through the rugged highland terrain.

hustle
The city's constant hustle and bustle can be exhausting.

a period of one thousand years
The year 2000 marked the start of a new millennium.

a person or thing that gives wise advice
She was considered an oracle of fashion advice.

a shared area or period
There's a significant overlap between their interests.

a large open area of grassland
Buffalo once roamed freely across the vast prairies.

a medical doctor specializing in mental illness
She decided to see a psychiatrist for her anxiety.

a hard mineral
The watch has a quartz movement, making it very accurate.

the process of decaying; nonsense
The old wood was starting to show signs of rot.

a person who writes songs
She is a talented songwriter and musician.

a written or printed version of material originally presented in another medium
I need a transcript of my academic records.

a long, narrow ditch
Soldiers dug a trench for protection during the war.

the state of being legally or officially acceptable
The validity of the contract was questioned.

the main team representing a university, college, or school
He played on the varsity basketball team.

the process of establishing the truth, accuracy, or validity of something
The verification of your identity is required.

a solemn promise
They exchanged wedding vows at the ceremony.

a Japanese school of Mahayana Buddhism emphasizing the value of meditation and intuition
He practices Zen meditation to find inner peace.

an assistant to an important person, especially a political leader
A presidential aide announced the new policy.

an icon or figure representing a particular person in a video game, internet forum, etc.
She created a unique avatar for her online profile.

a very large or fierce fire
The firefighters quickly extinguished the blaze.

a bar fixed across the front or back of a motor vehicle to protect it in a collision
The car's bumper was damaged in the accident.

a member of a council
The local councillor addressed the community meeting.

an official representing a country abroad
The diplomat worked to improve relations between the two nations.

a place where fish are caught or bred
The local fishery provides fresh seafood to restaurants.

the science or practice of planting, managing, and caring for forests
Forestry is important for sustainable timber production.

a half of the earth, usually divided into northern and southern halves
Australia is located in the Southern Hemisphere.

Intelligence Quotient
An IQ test measures a person's cognitive abilities.

the supply of water to land or crops to help growth
The new irrigation system significantly improved crop yields.

a market or trading center
The cattle mart was busy on auction day.

the middle part of a country or region
The river flows through the midland region.

a sovereign head of state, especially a king, queen, or emperor
The monarch delivered a speech to the nation.

the expression of sorrow for someone's death
The family was in deep mourning after the loss.

an ornamental tablet, typically of metal, porcelain, or wood, fixed to a wall or other surface in commemoration of a person or event
A bronze plaque was installed to honor the founder.

the quality or state of being pure
The purity of the water was tested.

a Jewish scholar or teacher, especially one who studies or teaches Jewish law
The rabbi led the congregation in prayer.

an act of rubbing something hard to clean it
The doctor gave the area a good scrub before the injection.

a type of rock
The cliffs were made of dark shale.

a lawyer
She consulted a solicitor about her property dispute.

a unit of military aircraft or ships
The squadron of fighter jets flew overhead.

a mark of disgrace
There is still a social stigma attached to mental illness.

an act of gaining control of a company
The company announced a hostile takeover bid.

dry, flammable material
He gathered some dry leaves and twigs for tinder.

a person who betrays
He was accused of being a traitor to his country.

the act of betraying
His betrayal of trust was unforgivable.

a limit or boundary
The dog cleared the fence in a single bound.
